opening_prompt.text: “Oh my god, what time is it for you?”

opening_responses.text: “hi! don't worry about it - did you have a good day?”
“Hi, sayang! It was a long day, but going out helped.”
“yeah it is quite late now, and I'm not feeling that great”
“Oh, Van… I’m sorry I wasn’t here.”
“It is 2 am here… our call was supposed to be at 11 pm. Have you just arrived at your place?”
“Yeah, I just got home. I’m sorry I kept you waiting… I didn’t realise how late it was.”

day_responses.text: “It was pretty bad. But talking to you right now makes it better already.”
“I felt so... alone. Like nobody is on my side and helping me through things.”
“you know.... it was bad, but you not being here on time makes it even worse”
“Yeah, well, I was hanging out with my friends.”

doctor_and_topic.text: “So, what happened? what makes you feel that way?”
“I went to the Doctor, and ugh... he told me I should see the specialist just in case. He said it is probably nothing, but it is making me anxious”
“I think it should be fine. Anyway, do you wanna know what I heard from my friend who is an Astronaut?”

topic_responses.text: “An astronaut? Okay, you’ve got me curious. What did they say?”
“So apparently… there’s something called a binary star.”
“I do wanna hear it, but... can we stay with this for a little longer? I’m still feeling anxious.”
“Oh—I thought you were done. So what else do you want to talk about in regards to that?”
“Seriously? I just told you what happened, and you’re already changing the subject?”
“Okay, okay. Just starts talking about it then... quick”

support_responses.text: “Hey, what's wrong? I feel like you are being a bit harsh towards me.”
“Sigh. I'm just realy tired. And I really don't feel like talking right now”
“I don't know. I'm just so anxious. It would make me feel better if you'd actually ask me follow up questions that makes me feel like you care about me”
“Sigh, okay. So what is it in particular making you feel anxious about this... whole deal?”
“What.... You sound like you don't really want to know.”
“No, I do want to know. Come on, just say what you need to say.”

reassurance.text: “It is just you know.... what if it is something that is sinister.”
“hey, you will be okay. you are young, and eats healthy. I don't think it will be anything serious.”

return_to_astronaut.text: “It’s okay, let’s watch that movie tomorrow.”
“Okay. What was it your astronaut friend told you?”
“So apparently… there’s something called a binary star.”

relationship_return.text: “About earlier… I still want to talk about why you came home so late.”

relationship_return_after_tired.text: “I know you’re tired. But you had the energy to talk to your friends, and I was waiting for you.”
